hook: One TH/s is a trillion guesses every single second.

scenes.narration: Hashrate is the number of hash attempts a miner makes each second.
One TH/s means one trillion hashes per second.
But it is only a share of the whole network's work, and your chance per block follows that share.
More hashrate also means more electricity, so efficiency in W/TH matters too.

cta: What number would you check first? Comment below, and the link is on my channel page.
title: What Does 1 TH/s Actually Mean?
description_body: Hashrate counts hash attempts per second, and one TH/s is one trillion of them.
